note: Set A and Set B contain the same 17 claims in substance, differing only in ordering and the singular/plural label 'handrail' vs 'handrails'. Both correctly capture the cladding, siding, handrail, solar tube, door swing/operation and Hardie reference facts with supporting quotes and conditions. Both also repeat the cladding material fact under three names and include the same window identifier claims, so neither has an advantage.
remarks: Both sets state the cedar cladding material three times (CEDAR, 1x4 tongue & groove cedar, plus separate profile/dimension claims), and the handrail 'material' value '2x4 CEDAR' folds a dimension into the material field. Window identifier claims (W2 1.06, W1 1.07) are label lookups of limited engineering use. Note W2 also appears with tag 1.04 and W1 with 1.03/1.05, so the identifier claims are not unique per window type.
